snapshot.reason: The proposed privatization scheme of arrangement and withdrawal of listing has officially lapsed due to the non-fulfillment of pre-conditions.
snapshot.why_now: The official joint announcement of the deal's collapse was filed on September 20, 2026, which will trigger an immediate downward re-rating as the privatization premium evaporates.
source_headlines: CHANGHONG JH (03991): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT - NON-FULFILLMENT OF PRE-CONDITIONS AND LAPSE OF THE PROPOSAL IN RELATION TO (1) PRE-CONDITIONAL PROPOSAL FOR THE PRIVATISATION OF CHANGHONG JIAHUA HOLDINGS LIMITED BY WAY OF A SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT UNDER SECTION 99 OF THE COMPANIES ACT AND (2) PROPOSED WITHDRAWAL OF LISTING OF CHANGHONG JIAHUA HOLDINGS LIMITED
